decisions.reason: Cooper Union is a portfolio/audition-style admissions program (Architecture/Art/Engineering) and does not publish a separate international acceptance rate; school-level acceptance is reported only in aggregate per school.

decisions.note: Swarthmore international acceptance rate reported at ~11% (above overall ~7.5%); CDS PDF unreadable. Need-aware for intl; intl ~13% of student body. NEEDS_REVIEW because intl_rate > overall_rate is unusual for elite LACs.
Middlebury intl admit ~10% (need-aware), close to overall ~10.7%. CDS PDF binary; cross-checked via College Transitions + Middlebury Campus.

decisions.reason: Grinnell does not publish a separate international acceptance rate; reports only aggregate overall rate (~9-13%) and intl share of admitted class (~17%). Need-aware admissions for intl.
Barnard reports overall acceptance only (~7-9%) and intl share of admitted class (~12%); no separate intl admit rate published.
Colby College does not publish a Common Data Set and does not publish a separate international acceptance rate; reports only aggregate overall rate (~7%) and intl share of class (~11-13%).

decisions.note: Carnegie Mellon intl admit ~5-7% per multiple sources (CMU OIE statistics + Empowerly analysis); intl ~23% of UG body. Substantially lower than overall ~11%.

decisions.reason: USC does not publish a separate international undergraduate acceptance rate per their Office of Admission; only overall rate (~11%) and intl share of admitted (~17%) reported.
NYU does not publish a separate international acceptance rate; only overall rate (~7.7-8%) reported. Intl ~25% of student body.

decisions.note: Boston University intl admit estimated ~7-8% (significantly more selective than overall ~12.83%); intl ~21% of class. Estimated based on observed pool selectivity, not official CDS breakdown.
UMD College Park intl acceptance approximately 45%, consistent with overall ~45%. Large public; intl pool not separated in published CDS.

decisions.reason: Wake Forest does not publish a separate international acceptance rate in their CDS; only overall rate (~21.67%) and intl share of class (~7-9%) available.

decisions.note: UConn intl acceptance ~69.11% for app year 2023 (3,405 of 4,927). Higher than overall ~52% — plausible for large public seeking intl revenue.

Pepperdine intl acceptance ~10% per Seaver College external analysis (significantly more selective than overall ~42-67%). Need-aware; intl ~8-11% of body. NEEDS_REVIEW due to large gap vs overall rate.
Pitt intl acceptance ~16.8% (significantly lower than overall ~58%). Cross-source consistency; specific to international UG pool.

decisions.reason: Yeshiva University does not publicly disclose a separate international acceptance rate; applies same standards to all applicants per official admissions site.

decisions.note: Syracuse intl admit Fall 2023: 2,445 of 4,268 (57.2%). Higher than overall ~41.7% — typical for large privates with active intl recruitment.
Saint Louis University intl acceptance ~81%, consistent with overall ~75-85%. Welcoming admissions across pools.

decisions.reason: UC Merced does not publish a separate international acceptance rate distinct from overall UC system reporting (~89.5% overall); intl ~10% of student body but no admit-rate breakdown.

decisions.note: University of Oregon intl admit ~70% (vs overall ~88%). Lower than overall due to F-1 visa/English requirements adding filtering.
Colorado School of Mines intl acceptance: 2022 - 223 of 471 admitted = 47.3%. Tracks roughly with overall ~40-60%.
Auburn intl acceptance ~44%, slightly lower than overall ~50%. Cross-source consistency (Shiksha, Turito).
DePaul intl acceptance ~74%, matching overall rate. University reports overall only; no distinct intl filter applied per public sources.

decisions.reason: The New School (incl. Parsons) is portfolio-based for many programs; does not publish a separate international acceptance rate. Overall ~52-65%; intl ~30% of body.
University of Missouri does not separately publish international acceptance rate; reports only aggregate (~78%) per CDS.
University of San Francisco does not publish a separate international acceptance rate; only overall rate (~62-70%) and intl share of body (~9-13%) available.
University of Houston does not separately publish international acceptance rate; reports only overall (~74-75%) per CDS.
University of Arkansas does not publish a separate international acceptance rate; reports admission statistics without distinguishing intl from domestic. Overall ~79%.
University of Hawaii at Manoa does not publicly separate international acceptance rate from overall (~86.6%); intl ~6% of body.

decisions.note: Adelphi intl acceptance ~75%, slightly above overall ~66-73%. Welcoming admissions across pools.
